name: intraday_range_reversion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, the session high and low become self-reinforcing order magnets: systematic TWAP/VWAP algorithms, stop-limit clusters, and delta-hedging desks concentrate resting orders at these levels throughout the day. When NIFTY touches its session extreme and the 5-second bar forms a rejection candle (close in the upper 65% of bar range at session low, lower 65% at session high), it signals that the algorithmic buy or sell wall has absorbed the directional flow. Within 30-90 seconds, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms aggressively fade the extreme because their fill price relative to benchmark has become highly attractive, driving a 12-25 spot point reversion toward the session midpoint.

indicators.name: session_high
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session high — no scaling needed, it is a running extreme since market open. The session extreme is the same concept regardless of bar size; what matters is where the institutional order wall sits, not how many bars have passed.

indicators.name: session_low
indicators.purpose: Cumulative session low — same rationale as session_high. Cumulative measures do not require period scaling.

indicators.name: range_pct
indicators.purpose: Quality filter ensuring a meaningful intraday range exists before trading the reversion. Threshold 0.5% chosen because NIFTY needs at least ~100 spot points of range to generate a tradeable 12+ point reversion target. In the original equity strategy this was 0.8% on individual stocks; for the NIFTY index which moves in tighter % terms, 0.5% is more appropriate.

indicators.name: pin_bar_long_score
indicators.purpose: Single-bar hammer score: measures what fraction of the bar's range the close is above the low. Score > 0.65 means close is in the upper 35% of the bar — sellers tried to push lower but buyers absorbed it within this 5-second bar. Threshold slightly relaxed from original 0.7 because 5-second bars have noisier wicks.

indicators.name: pin_bar_short_score
indicators.purpose: Single-bar shooting-star score: measures what fraction of the bar's range the close is below the high. Score > 0.65 means close is in the lower 35% of the bar — buyers tried to push higher but sellers absorbed it. Same 5-second bar noise adjustment as long score.

conditions: low <= session_low * (1 + proximity_pct) — bar touched within 0.2% of session low
close > session_low — bar closed above the extreme (rejection confirmed within 5s)
pin_bar_long_score > 0.65 — hammer pattern: close in upper 35% of bar range
VIX between 13 and 23 — not too calm (no range) or too chaotic (breakout regime)
buy_ce.confirmation: Signal fires on the rejection bar itself. Unlike original 1-min strategy, no next-bar confirmation is needed — at 5-second resolution the bar already represents real-time pattern completion and the reversion begins immediately.

conditions: high >= session_high * (1 - proximity_pct) — bar touched within 0.2% of session high
close < session_high — bar closed below the extreme (rejection confirmed within 5s)
pin_bar_short_score > 0.65 — shooting star: close in lower 35% of bar range
buy_pe.confirmation: Signal fires on the rejection bar itself.

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points (~8 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). If NIFTY continues past the session extreme by 8+ spot points, the algorithmic support wall has failed — a genuine breakout is underway and the reversion thesis is invalid. Tight stop is appropriate since we enter precisely at the extreme with clearly defined failure condition.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option points (~12 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5). NIFTY session extremes typically produce 20-40 spot point first-leg reversions; capturing 12 points is conservative (30-60% of median move) and achievable within 90 seconds as VWAP benchmarked buy-side algorithms adjust positions. This gives 1:1.5 risk:reward.

filters.vix_filter: VIX 13-23: below 13 means NIFTY intraday range is too narrow (<80 pts) for meaningful reversion; above 23 means breakouts dominate over reversions and session extremes are routinely breached
filters.time_filter: entries only 10:00-14:45 IST (600-885 min from midnight) — allows 45 minutes for a meaningful range to establish from 09:15 open before accepting signals
filters.volume_filter: none — NIFTY index volume is noisy at 5-second resolution and unreliable as a filter
filters.trend_filter: none — mean-reversion at range extremes does not benefit from trend filter; the extreme itself is the structural signal
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — session high/low reversion is a well-known pattern; HFT likely front-runs the rejection by milliseconds; edge depends on NIFTY maintaining a ranging (not trending) intraday character

adaptation_notes: Original trades individual NIFTY200 stocks using 1-min bars. Converted to NIFTY index because: (1) session high/low are equally valid on the index — institutions actively reference these levels for TWAP execution and delta hedging; (2) pin bar pattern is cleaner on NIFTY at 5s because the index smooths individual stock idiosyncratic noise; (3) hold time compressed from 10-40 min to 30-90 seconds — we capture the first institutional response wave, not the full reversion. Key changes: (a) no next-bar confirmation required — at 5s the rejection bar is already real-time; (b) proximity threshold relaxed from 0.1% to 0.2% because NIFTY moves in larger absolute terms; (c) range_pct threshold reduced from 0.8% to 0.5% as index has tighter % ranges than individual stocks; (d) ATR_14 indicator dropped — not needed at 5s where we use fixed option point stops calibrated to typical NIFTY moves.
weaknesses: Pin bar quality degrades at 5-second resolution — many bars near session extremes will have wicks without genuine absorption; signal frequency may be too high with false patterns
On directional days (gap-and-go regime), session extremes are launching pads not reversal points — strategy will consistently lose when VIX > 20 and early momentum is strong
Only 1-3 signals per day; statistical significance requires months of data to assess edge
90-second hold captures only the first 30-40% of a typical session extreme reversion — larger moves are left on the table
